stories.summary: NSW Building (Approvals and Practitioners) Act 2026 assented, replaces certifier system with staged approvals.
NSW releases 20-year Sydney Plan targeting 1.3 million new residents by 2046.
Lendlease sells $1bn+ retail stakes to Cbus Property, wins Redcliffe Hospital expansion contract.
Sydney Airport expansion plans approved, five-year initial delivery window.
Albanese lobbies Trump for full tariff exemption or rate freeze for Australia.
NSW commits $32.3m and AI licensing pilot to implement new Building Act; duty-of-care detail clarified.
Trump officials float capital-gains tax cut on primary home sales ahead of midterms.
Hyatt adds 37th brand, Hôtel Banke Opéra becomes Radisson Collection, Amàre Cancún opens under Curio by Hilton.
ApartmentIQ raises $25M from Susquehanna Growth Equity for AI multifamily intelligence platform.
Wonder food-hall/delivery concept closes $650M Series D at ~$9.65B valuation.
